subject: OCR & scanned document workflows / your MLOps pipeline
text:
Hi [NAME]​, 

Saw [COMPANY]'s Series A - imagine scaling Astra OS for hospital ops is now the next priority. With partners like HIRC and systems like Yale and Cleveland Clinic on board, I imagine the volume of scanned vendor docs, PDFs, and unstructured inputs is only growing. 

At Encord, we're working with teams like Viz.ai and care.ai to improve how these kinds of documents get labeled, parsed, and reviewed - pairing OCR with annotation workflows that support compliance and auditability at scale. If you're working on anything around extracting structured signals from scanned docs or standardising vendor formats, I'd love to compare notes. 

Would you be open to a 20-min chat? Wednesdays or Thursdays usually work best.

subject: Scaling doc models: edge cases, ontologies, QA
text:
Hi [NAME]​, 

Saw [COMPANY]'s recent growth - I imagine expanding your document models is putting pressure on annotation, QA, and evaluation workflows.

At Encord, we help streamline this layer with LLM-assisted pre-labeling, structured ontologies, and human-in-the-loop QA - accelerating iteration without compromising precision. 

Would you be open to a quick chat? Tuesdays or Thursdays tend to work best on my end.

text:

Congratulations on completing the first unmanned, deep-water cable route
survey - sounds like the beginning of a fruitful partnership with Meta. I
figured there's a good chance you'll be at CVPR later this week - so I'd
love to introduce myself in person.

connect.

for model development. We focus on consolidating data curation, annotation
and model evaluation with the goals of efficiency gains for training
dataset preparation & model iterations.

conference Friday (6/13) to Sunday (6/15). If virtual is easier, happy to
find a time that suits you!

subject: Working w/ SmartEye, Cipia & Toyota | [COMPANY] Autosense
text:
Hi [NAME]​, 

I noticed [COMPANY]'s recent focus on DMS - especially the EU homologation & large automotive contracts - so thought I'd reach out. I lead an automotive team here at Encord and we're working w/ a few of your peers (SmartEye, Toyota, Cipia, Nauto, Seeing Machines, etc) to develop new AI/CV products & scale use cases like driver behavior analytics, in-cabin monitoring, safety alerts & 2D/3D Skeletons using a single-camera OMS. 

We're mostly assisting with multimodal data visualisation at scale (billions) & dimensionality reduction for feature engineering, edge case mining & model eval for decision threshold tuning and annotation workflow orchestration as the team size grows or as they expand into more complex modalities like video or audio. 

Keen to trade notes & get your thoughts on what we're building if you're be open to a 30-minute chat this week or the next? Wednesdays and Thursdays usually work for me.
